model_output.score_comment_short: The accounting duties are clear, but the descriptions rarely explain the work.
model_output.score_comment_long: The move from accounts payable clerk to staff accountant gives the resume a clear direction. The recent bullets name core accounting tasks but leave their particulars largely unexplained. Adding a few concrete examples of close and audit work would make the experience easier to assess.
model_output.score_plain: A reviewer can identify your accounting background quickly, but may have difficulty comparing your work with a specific role's requirements.
model_output.first_impression: Your current staff accountant title and accounting degree are easy to find. The experience bullets are brief enough to scan, but most stop at the name of a task.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Responsible for month-end close tasks" doesn't identify the tasks, so a reviewer cannot tell what part of the close you handle.
model_output.summary: Your move from Accounts Payable Clerk to Staff Accountant at Rivermark shows a progression into broader accounting work. The combination of journal entries, reconciliations, fixed assets and audit assistance supports a staff-level accounting read. Naming the purchase order-to-receipt matching in your earlier role is worth keeping because it shows a specific part of the payables process. What you handle during month-end close remains unclear, which makes it difficult to compare your current responsibilities with another staff accountant role.
strengths: The Rivermark roles show a clear progression from vendor invoices and payment questions to general accounting duties.
QuickBooks, NetSuite and Excel functions are named, giving reviewers concrete tools to compare with a posting.
The accounting degree includes the school and graduation year, making your education straightforward to verify.
gaps: The types of accounts you reconcile aren't named, leaving the journal entry and reconciliation work broad.
The audit bullet doesn't say what you prepare or provide, so your contribution to the annual audit is unclear.
The fixed asset bullet doesn't explain which schedule updates you handle, making the responsibility difficult to distinguish from general record maintenance.

top_fixes.why: This would give a reviewer a more useful picture of your fixed asset responsibilities.
